text.source: Results: county returns as published by NBC News (from the Associated Press) on Nov 7, 2026, with about 98% of the expected vote counted statewide. Counts are unofficial until certified. Shares are two-party (Julie Fedorchak vs. Trygve Hammer, Democratic-NPL); independent Charles Tuttle is left out. Swing compares with the 2024 U.S. House county results (two-party share). Residents: Census Bureau July 1, 2025 county estimates (Vintage 2025, table co-est2025-pop-38).
